patch_list: Removes all seven ad placements and the ad SDK bootstrap, the Google UMP consent flow, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics collection, the advertising ID, Facebook SDK auto-init and third-party IP geolocation. The encrypted Titanium bundle is r…

Stops Titanium's Crashlytics exception reporter. Required together with the ad/tracking patch: the reporter calls FirebaseCrashlytics after that component is removed, which otherwise crashes the app on any JavaScript exception.
Required for a patched (re-signed) Upflix: skips the Google Play (PairIP) license check that would otherwise close the app.
